spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the explainer's primary use case — reinterpreting one variable's bytes as multiple types — with the real surfaces: var<storage, read> src : buffer<16>, *bufferView<vec4u>(&src, 0u) and *bufferView<vec4f>(&src, 0u) over the same bytes, plus bufferLength(&src). Offsets respect RequiredAlignOf(vec4f)=16. The prose honestly notes bitcast covers the scalar case and that buffer_view's value is reinterpreting memory including aggregates.

interactive.rationale: Four editable float inputs drive a real pack-writeBuffer-dispatch-readback pipeline; the CPU DataView reference recomputes on input change (verified via CDP: setting float 0 to 2 immediately showed 0x40000000). The GPU column can only be filled by a real readback, and mismatches render as loud MISMATCH cells — the check cannot pass silently.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the same 16 bytes read as vec4f and vec4u with a bit-for-bit CPU comparison; that is precisely the table.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles no-WebGPU, null adapter, and compile failure distinctly; non-finite input parses to 0 via Math.fround guard; CPU float accumulation mirrors f32 semantics with Math.fround per step so the sum comparison is not falsely strict; pipeline/device promises reset on failure so a later retry is possible.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus 5094091886034944, feature page, and the proposal are linked.

conformance.rationale: The suite's buffer-type-and-bufferview-compile assertion compiles this page's exact reinterpretation pattern; ran in-session with the honest fail-until-supported result.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 + SwiftShader: page loads clean, CPU reference table correct (1 -> 0x3f800000, -2.5 -> 0xc0200000, 0.1 -> 0x3dcccccd), unsupported panel shows the real compile error, input-change and Pack & dispatch driven via CDP with clean console. The actual GPU dispatch/readback/match path has never executed because no available browser supports buffer_view — the match cells are unobserved code.

telemetry_health.rationale: bufferview-punning-match asserts lanes+sum+bufferLength equality only after a real readback; bufferview-punning-fallback fires separately with the failure reason, so the fallback can never read as success.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; match cells use black-on-emerald (fixed from a failing ivory-on-emerald draft), mismatch ivory-on-rose ~5.3:1; inputs are box-sizing:border-box after a 6px mobile overflow was measured and fixed.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled number inputs, native button, aria-live=polite status describing the run outcome, table with caption and th scope=col, monospace values with overflow-wrap. Match/mismatch is conveyed by cell text (match / MISMATCH / n/a), not colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360x740 DPR3: scrollWidth 360 after the input box-sizing fix (was 366); inputs and button stack full-width; the comparison table scrolls inside its own overflow-x wrapper; full-page mobile and 1280x1900 desktop screenshots read. CLI 360 captures hit the known headless clamp, so CDP was authoritative.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel layout without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap control rows, make wide data scroll in its own container, and avoid width+padding overflow on form controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Found and fixed a real 6px overflow from width:8.5rem+padding inputs by adding box-sizing:border-box; table min-width 520px scrolls inside .tablewrap; page-level overflow measured at exactly 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce async operation result status live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Async results should be announced via polite live regions and not rely on colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status output is aria-live=polite and summarises lanes/sum/bufferLength outcomes in text; verdict cells carry text labels in addition to colour.

openQuestions.title: GPU readback path unexecuted anywhere
openQuestions.detail: The dispatch, staging-buffer readback, and match/MISMATCH rendering have only been exercised up to the honest compile failure. On a buffer_view-enabled build, run the page, confirm all four lanes plus sum and bufferLength match, and confirm endianness assumptions (JS typed arrays vs GPU little-endian) hold on real hardware.

summary: The type-punning demo wires user floats through one storage buffer into a shader that reads the bytes as vec4f and vec4u, with a CPU DataView ground truth that renders immediately and cannot be faked into a pass. In this session's Chromium 141 the CPU column, input reactivity, honest unsupported panel (real compile error text), and clean console were all verified; the GPU match path awaits a buffer_view-enabled Chrome.
